text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that usually require human intelligence. This includes understanding language, recognizing images, and making decisions. Machine learning is a part of AI that allows computers to learn from data without being programmed for every situation. Deep learning, a more advanced form of machine learning, uses neural networks to solve complex problems. Today, AI is used in many daily activities, such as voice assistants, search engines, online recommendations, and self-driving cars. AI is changing the way we live and work.
